elements.requirement: An order made under section 23 by virtue of section 25B or 25C that imposes a requirement on the person responsible for a first pension arrangement takes effect instead against the person responsible for a new pension arrangement if the party with pension rights acquires rights under the new arrangement derived directly or indirectly from the whole of their rights under the first arrangement, and the person responsible for the new arrangement has received notice in accordance with regulations made by the Lord Chancellor.
elements.quote: the order shall have effect as if it had been made instead in respect of the person responsible for the new arrangement.

elements.requirement: The Lord Chancellor may make regulations regarding the person to whom, and the terms on which, a payment is to be made where a court order under section 23 requires the person responsible for a pension arrangement to make a payment for the benefit of the other party.
elements.quote: make provision as to the person to whom, and the terms on which, the payment is to be made

elements.requirement: The Lord Chancellor may make regulations concerning the rights or liabilities of the payer, payee, or intended recipient where a payment is made under a mistaken belief that a provision included in an order under section 23 by virtue of section 25B or 25C remains in force.
elements.quote: make, in relation to payment under a mistaken belief as to the continuation in force of a provision included by virtue of section 25B or 25C above in an order under section 23 above, provision about the rights or liabilities of the payer, the payee or the person to whom the payment was due

elements.requirement: The Lord Chancellor may make regulations requiring notices to be given regarding changes of circumstances relevant to section 23 orders that include provisions made by virtue of sections 25B and 25C.
elements.quote: require notices to be given in respect of changes of circumstances relevant to such orders which include provision made by virtue of sections 25B and 25C above

elements.requirement: The Lord Chancellor may make regulations specifying prescribed circumstances in which the person responsible for a pension arrangement is discharged from a requirement imposed by virtue of section 25B or 25C.
elements.quote: make provision for the person responsible for a pension arrangement to be discharged in prescribed circumstances from a requirement imposed by virtue of section 25B or 25C above

elements.requirement: The Lord Chancellor may make regulations requiring the trustees or managers of any pension scheme to provide information as to the value of any scheme benefits for the purposes of orders under section 23.
elements.quote: make provision for the trustees or managers of any pension scheme to provide, for the purposes of orders under section 23 above, information as to the value of any benefits under the scheme

elements.requirement: The Lord Chancellor may make regulations providing for the recovery of administrative expenses incurred in complying with orders containing section 25B or 25C provisions and in providing scheme benefit information, from either the party with pension rights or the other party.
elements.quote: make provision for the recovery of the administrative expenses of— (i) complying with such orders, so far as they include provision made by virtue of sections 25B and 25C above, and (ii) providing such information, from the party with pension rights or the other party

elements.requirement: The Lord Chancellor may make regulations governing the calculation and verification of the value of benefits under a pension arrangement or shareable state scheme rights for the purposes of the court's functions under Part II of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973.
elements.quote: make provision about calculation and verification in relation to the valuation of— (i) benefits under a pension arrangement, or (ii) shareable state scheme rights, for the purposes of the court’s functions in connection with the exercise of any of its powers under this Part of this Act.

elements.requirement: Regulations governing the valuation of pension arrangement benefits or shareable state scheme rights may provide for values to be calculated and verified according to guidance prepared and periodically revised by a prescribed person and approved by the Secretary of State.
elements.quote: regulations made by virtue of paragraph (e) above may provide for that value to be calculated and verified in accordance with guidance which is prepared and from time to time revised by a prescribed person and approved by the Secretary of State.

elements.requirement: Regulations governing calculation and verification under subsection (2)(e) may include provision for calculation or verification in accordance with guidance prepared from time to time by a prescribed person.
elements.quote: provision for calculation or verification in accordance with guidance from time to time prepared by a prescribed person

elements.requirement: Regulations governing calculation and verification under subsection (2)(e) may include provision by reference to regulations made under section 30 or section 49(4) of the Welfare Reform and Pensions Act 1999.
elements.quote: provision by reference to regulations under section 30 or 49(4) of the Welfare Reform and Pensions Act 1999.

elements.requirement: Regulations made by the Lord Chancellor under subsection (2) of section 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973 may make different provision for different cases.
elements.quote: Regulations under subsection (2) above may make different provision for different cases.

elements.requirement: Any power to make regulations under section 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973 must be exercised by statutory instrument subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament.
elements.quote: Power to make regulations under this section shall be exercisable by statutory instrument which shall be subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament.

elements.requirement: For the purposes of sections 25B, 25C, and 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973, 'occupational pension scheme' bears the meaning set out in the Pension Schemes Act 1993.
elements.quote: “occupational pension scheme” has the same meaning as in the Pension Schemes Act 1993

elements.requirement: For the purposes of sections 25B, 25C, and 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973, 'the party with pension rights' means the party to the marriage who has or is likely to have benefits under a pension arrangement, and 'the other party' means the other party to the marriage.
elements.quote: “the party with pension rights” means the party to the marriage who has or is likely to have benefits under a pension arrangement and “the other party” means the other party to the marriage

elements.requirement: For the purposes of sections 25B, 25C, and 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973, a 'pension arrangement' is defined as an occupational pension scheme, a personal pension scheme, a retirement annuity contract, an annuity or insurance policy purchased or transferred to give effect to rights under an occupational or personal pension scheme, or an annuity purchased or entered into to discharge liability for a pension credit under section 29(1)(b) of the Welfare Reform and Pensions Act 1999 or corresponding Northern Ireland legislation.
elements.quote: “pension arrangement” means— an occupational pension scheme,a personal pension scheme,a retirement annuity contract,an annuity or insurance policy purchased, or transferred, for the purpose of giving effect to rights under an occupational pension scheme or a personal pension scheme, andan annuity purchased, or entered into, for the purpose of discharging liability in respect of a pension credit under section 29(1)(b) of the Welfare Reform and Pensions Act 1999 or under corresponding Northern Ireland legislation

elements.requirement: For the purposes of sections 25B, 25C, and 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973, 'personal pension scheme' bears the meaning set out in the Pension Schemes Act 1993.
elements.quote: “personal pension scheme” has the same meaning as in the Pension Schemes Act 1993

elements.requirement: For the purposes of sections 25B, 25C, and 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973, 'prescribed' means prescribed by regulations.
elements.quote: “prescribed” means prescribed by regulations

elements.requirement: For the purposes of sections 25B, 25C, and 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973, 'retirement annuity contract' means a contract or scheme approved under Chapter III of Part XIV of the Income and Corporation Taxes Act 1988.
elements.quote: “retirement annuity contract” means a contract or scheme approved under Chapter III of Part XIV of the Income and Corporation Taxes Act 1988

elements.requirement: For the purposes of sections 25B, 25C, and 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973, 'shareable state scheme rights' bears the meaning provided in section 21A(1) of the Act.
elements.quote: “shareable state scheme rights” has the same meaning as in section 21A(1) above

elements.requirement: For the purposes of an occupational pension scheme or personal pension scheme under sections 25B, 25C, and 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973, 'trustees or managers' means the trustees if the scheme is established under a trust, or the managers in any other case.
elements.quote: “trustees or managers”, in relation to an occupational pension scheme or a personal pension scheme, means— in the case of a scheme established under a trust, the trustees of the scheme, andin any other case, the managers of the scheme.

elements.requirement: In sections 25B, 25C, and 25D of the Matrimonial Causes Act 1973, the 'person responsible for a pension arrangement' means the trustees or managers for an occupational or personal pension scheme, the provider of the annuity for a retirement annuity contract or qualifying annuity, and the insurer for a qualifying insurance policy.
elements.quote: references to the person responsible for a pension arrangement are— (a) in the case of an occupational pension scheme or a personal pension scheme, to the trustees or managers of the scheme, (b) in the case of a retirement annuity contract or an annuity falling within paragraph (d) or (e) of the definition of “pension arrangement” above, the provider of the annuity, and (c) in the case of an insurance policy falling within paragraph (d) of the definition of that expression, the insurer.
